# `Q-7-7` — No Renderable Files Matched

> An input directory or glob matched no renderable files.

## What this means

When you pass a directory path or a glob pattern to
`quarto render`, Quarto expands it to a list of renderable
files
(`.qmd`, `.md`, and similar). This error fires when the
expansion is empty — the directory has no `.qmd` files in it,
or the glob matched only non-renderable files.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **A glob that does not match anything** —
  `quarto render docs/*.qmd` in a directory with no `.qmd`
  files at the top level.
- **A directory holding only output files** (`_site/`) and no
  sources.
- **A typo in the directory name** — Quarto found the
  directory but it was not the one you meant.

## How to fix

Check what the glob expands to from the shell (`ls docs/*.qmd`).
If that command lists no files, your glob is the problem; if it
lists files but Quarto still reports none, the files may be
hidden or underscore-prefixed (which Quarto excludes by
default).

## Related
